category_overview: These six tools sit on top of the general assistants and office suites as the "output layer": they turn text, data and documents into decks, graphics, prototypes and summaries. Gamma and Canva compete head-on for prompt-to-presentation and on-brand collateral (Gamma even launched Gamma Imagine in March 2026 explicitly to take on Canva and Adobe), while Adobe Firefly is the brand-safe image/video engine that marketing teams use when IP indemnification and Content Credentials matter. Acrobat AI Assistant is a different category (document comprehension and knowledge hubs over PDFs) that now overlaps with Microsoft Copilot, NotebookLM and Canva Sheets through PDF Spaces, generated presentations and podcasts. Figma AI and FigJam AI are the product-design pair: Figma for high-fidelity design and prompt-to-code prototypes, FigJam for workshops and research synthesis, with one seat model and one AI-credit pool. Enterprises typically standardise on the suite they already license (Adobe for creative and PDF, Figma for product teams) and then allow one AI presentation tool (Gamma or Canva) under a Business/Enterprise tier where content training is contractually off; the recurring governance issue across all six is consumption-based AI credits and the fact that free/individual tiers of Gamma, Canva and Figma train on user content by default.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.vendor: Gamma Tech, Inc. (San Francisco; brief's 'Gamma Tech' guess is correct). Products: Gamma web/mobile app, Gamma Imagine graphics, Gamma API and MCP connectors.
tools.what_it_is: An AI-native browser app (plus iOS/Android) that generates presentations ('gammas'), documents, websites, social posts and, since March 2026, standalone graphics from a prompt or an imported PDF/PPTX. It is used as a stand-alone SaaS workspace, and increasingly from inside ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Slack via MCP connectors and a public API.
key_capabilities: Prompt-to-deck with up to 100 slides per prompt on paid tiers; import PDF/PPTX, export PDF, PPTX, PNG and Google Slides
Multi-model backend (Claude, OpenAI GPT/DALL-E, Gemini, Flux, Recraft, Ideogram, Luma, Leonardo) selectable by plan tier
Custom brand themes, custom domains, analytics and advanced sharing (Pro and above)
Gamma Imagine: on-brand logos, infographics, social graphics and Smart Charts (bar, scatter, funnel, heatmap) that inherit brand styling
37 connectors/integrations (Slack, Notion, Atlassian, HubSpot, Gong, Zapier, Make, n8n, Microsoft Copilot) to build decks from live content
Public API and developer docs for automated deck generation
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Team/Business/Enterprise workspaces: training opt-out is locked for the whole workspace (official help centre). Individual Free/Plus/Pro/Ultra: content used to train Gamma features by default with user opt-out (third-party trust summary, verified 2026-09-30). SOC 2 Type II report (2025) and 2026 penetration test published at trust.gamma.app; SSO on Business and Enterprise; SCIM, audit logs with SIEM export, guest and sharing restrictions, connector/API governance only on Enterprise. DPA with EU SCCs; data processed in the US with no EU residency option; AI subprocessors OpenAI, Anthropic, Google. No ISO 27001, HIPAA or FedRAMP claimed.
tools.licensing_pricing: Prices are geo-localised (the pricing page rendered in BRL). Official help centre: Business US$40 per member per month billed annually (10,000 credits/seat); Enterprise custom annual agreement, invoiced. Competitor-published USD list (Presentations.AI, Oct 2026, treat as indicative): Plus US$12/mo (US$9 annual), Pro US$25 (US$18), Ultra US$100 (US$90), Team US$20/seat annual with 2-seat minimum. Free: 400 one-time credits. Annual billing saves up to 30%; unused credits roll over up to 2x the monthly amount. Not bundled with any suite.
tools.integrations: Slack (@Gamma), Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT and Claude (MCP), Notion, Atlassian Jira/Confluence/Rovo, HubSpot, Gong, Fathom/Fireflies/Read AI meeting notes, Zapier, Make, n8n, Stripe, Hex, Box/Dropbox/Egnyte, Highspot, Responsive (RFP answers), Google Slides export.
tools.recent_developments: Nov 2025: US$68M Series B led by Andreessen Horowitz at US$2.1B valuation; US$100M ARR, 70M users, ~50 staff (TechCrunch). Oct 2025: SOC 2 Type II achieved. 17 Mar 2026: Gamma Imagine launched (AI graphics, 100+ remixable templates, Smart Charts) positioning against Canva/Adobe. 2026: Enterprise tier with SCIM, audit logs and connector governance; 37-integration ecosystem. Caution: April 2025 reports of gamma.app links abused in phishing campaigns (Wikipedia).
tools.best_fit_departments: Strongest: 28/29 Sales, 34 Business Development, 35 Pre-Sales (proposal and QBR decks from CRM/Gong data), 31 Marketing, 13 L&D, 54 PMO status decks, 01 Office of the CEO and 27 Investor Relations briefs, 57 Change communications. Weak: 50 BI (Smart Charts are presentation charts, not governed BI), 53 Enterprise Architecture, 58 Quality Management, 19 Health & Safety and 10 ESG, where Gamma only packages analysis done elsewhere.
tools.training_notes: Learn outline-first prompting, brand theme setup, credit budgeting, verifying every generated fact and chart, sharing/public-link hygiene, and PPTX export fidelity checks. Core 6-8 hours for deck builders; Advanced 12-16 hours for RevOps/automation users wiring connectors, Zapier/Make flows or the API.
tools.caveats: Consumption credits run out quickly with image/video models; PPTX export loses some interactivity; US-only hosting; individual plans train on content by default; free public gamma links have been abused for phishing so publish controls matter; prices vary by country; small vendor with rapid plan changes.

tools.name: Canva Magic Studio
tools.vendor: Canva Pty Ltd (Sydney). Brief's 'Canva' guess is correct. RENAME: canva.com/magic now redirects to the 'Canva AI' page; the Magic Studio name survives mainly in older Canva Shield material. Also note 'Canva Teams' is closed to new sign-ups and replaced by 'Canva Business'.
tools.what_it_is: The AI layer inside Canva's browser, desktop and mobile editor: Magic Write copy, photo/video generators, Resize, Magic Layers, Canva Code, Dream Lab and, since April 2026, the conversational, agentic 'Canva AI 2.0' assistant. It lives inside Canva's Visual Suite (designs, docs, presentations, Sheets, websites) rather than as a separate app.
key_capabilities: Conversational design: describe a brief and get fully layered, editable designs with brand fonts/colours applied (Canva AI 2.0, research preview)
Brand Kits and Brand Intelligence with approvals (5 kits Pro, 100 Business, 1,000 Enterprise with tiered approvals)
Connectors pulling context from Slack, Gmail, Google Drive/Calendar, Notion, Zoom, HubSpot, Microsoft, Atlassian, Linear; scheduled recurring tasks and web research
Magic Write, Translate, Resize across formats and languages; Canva Craft image model, Video Generator, Magic Layers
Canva Code 2.0 interactive experiences and Sheets AI for spreadsheets/charts
Affinity (free pro design suite) with AI features for paid Canva users; Flourish data visualisation on Business
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Teams, Business, Enterprise and Education content is not used to improve AI features and this cannot be turned on (Canva Shield, Jan 2026). Free and Pro: use governed by per-user Privacy Settings. Business/Enterprise Org Admins can enable or disable AI tools by role. Canva Shield includes IP indemnification for enterprise customers with over 100 seats at no extra cost. Enterprise adds SSO, SCIM provisioning, multi-team controls; DPA offered for Business and Enterprise only. Data is stored in the United States. Certifications listed: SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, EU-US DPF; no HIPAA or FedRAMP listed.
tools.licensing_pricing: US list (yearly billing): Free US$0; Pro US$144/year for one person; Business US$250/year per person; Enterprise contact sales (dedicated success manager at 150+ seats). Monthly billing costs more ('save from 16%' yearly). AI allowance per month: Free up to 20 Standard/Premium uses; Pro up to 200 Premium or 20 Ultra; Business/Enterprise up to 400 Premium or 40 Ultra; AI Pass add-on gives 40x Pro / 20x Business allowance. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. Page prices geo-localise (S$165/S$250 shown in Singapore).
tools.integrations: Canva AI connectors (Slack, Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, Zoom, HubSpot, Microsoft, Atlassian, Linear); Affinity-Claude AI connector for scripted production tasks; Flourish and Canva Sheets for marketing reporting; Canva apps marketplace.
tools.recent_developments: Oct 2025: Creative Operating System and Canva Design Model launched; Affinity relaunched as a free unified app. 2025: Canva Business introduced between Pro and Enterprise; 260M monthly users, US$3.5B revenue. Jan 2026: Canva Shield policy refreshed. 16 Apr 2026 (Canva Create): Canva AI 2.0 research preview (connectors, scheduling, web research, Sheets AI, Canva Code 2.0), Canva Offline, Learn Grid, Cavalry free. Sept 2026: Affinity 3.3 under the 'Canva ProSuite' umbrella. Aug 2026: US law firm investigating consumer-tier AI-training consent (business tiers unaffected).
tools.best_fit_departments: Strongest: 31 Marketing & Brand and 32 Digital Marketing (on-brand creative at scale, ad insights), 13 L&D (Interactive Activities, training videos), 57 Change Management communications, 18 Workplace Admin signage/notices, 29 SMB Sales collateral. Weak: 38 CX and 40 UX Research - Canva is not a journey-mapping or wireframing system of record; use for presentation of findings only.
tools.training_notes: Master Brand Kit governance and approvals, template locking, prompt craft for Magic Write/image tools, AI-allowance budgeting, output review for IP and brand safety, and Privacy Settings/admin toggles. Core 6-8 hours; Advanced 12-16 hours for Canva AI 2.0 connectors, scheduled jobs and Canva Code.
tools.caveats: AI 'uses' are opaque and vary by tool complexity; frequent rebranding (Magic Studio to Canva AI, Teams to Business) confuses licensing; indemnification only above 100 seats; US-only data storage; connectors give the assistant access to mail and chat and need governance; Canva AI 2.0 is a research preview.

tools.name: Adobe Firefly
tools.vendor: Adobe Inc. (brief's guess correct). Firefly is both the family of Adobe generative models and the Firefly web/mobile app; enterprise variants are Firefly Services APIs, Firefly Custom Models, Firefly Creative Production and Firefly Foundry.
tools.what_it_is: Adobe's generative AI studio for images, video, audio and vectors, available as a web app and mobile apps, embedded inside Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe Express, Premiere and Lightroom, and exposed through APIs for automation. It positions itself as 'commercially safe': models trained on licensed Adobe Stock and public-domain content, with Content Credentials attached to outputs.
key_capabilities: Text-to-image and Prompt to Edit with Firefly Image Model 5 (native 4MP, improved people), Generative Fill/Expand, background and object removal, upscaling
Partner models in one interface: Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT, FLUX, Runway, Luma, ElevenLabs, Topaz, Kling 3.0 (video) - with Adobe or partner model choice per task
Video and audio: text/image-to-video, Generate Soundtrack, Generate Speech, audio/video translation in 20+ languages, AI video editor (beta)
Firefly Boards collaborative mood/storyboarding canvas with PDF export and Premiere handoff
Custom Models (beta) trained on approved brand assets; Firefly Foundry for proprietary enterprise-scale models (with NVIDIA)
Firefly Services APIs and Creative Production for bulk variations across thousands of assets
tools.enterprise_data_handling: All tiers: Adobe states it does not train Firefly on any Creative Cloud or Experience Cloud subscriber content; models trained on Adobe Stock, openly licensed and public-domain content. Content Credentials auto-applied to Firefly-generated assets. Enterprise: contractual IP indemnification for 'select Firefly outputs' only when the organisation buys the entitlement via the Adobe Express and Firefly site license or certain Creative Cloud for enterprise plans (new contracting event); confirm with Adobe whether partner-model outputs are covered. Teams plans add Admin Console seat controls. Compliance (Creative Cloud for enterprise incl. Express and Firefly): SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, FedRAMP Tailored; HIPAA not listed. Note: if Firefly is included in a plan, the entitlement cannot be switched off, only not used.
tools.licensing_pricing: Individuals (USD, monthly): Free limited; Standard US$9.99 (2,000 credits); Pro US$19.99 (4,000, includes Express Premium and Photoshop web/mobile); Pro Plus US$49.99 (10,000); Premium US$199.99 (50,000, unlimited Firefly Video Model). Teams (annual, billed monthly per license): Pro US$19.99, Pro Plus US$49.99, Premium US$199.99 with Admin Console and 24x7 support. Enterprise: contact sales (Custom Models, Foundry, Services APIs unpriced). Bundled: Firefly features and credits are included in Creative Cloud apps and Adobe Express; Acrobat Studio includes Express Premium with Firefly-powered tools.
tools.integrations: Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe Express, Premiere, Lightroom, Adobe Stock; GenStudio for Performance Marketing; Firefly Services APIs; Frame.io; Premiere Pro handoff from Boards.
tools.recent_developments: Oct 2025 (Adobe MAX): Firefly Image Model 5 beta, expanded partner models, Generate Soundtrack and Generate Speech betas, AI video editor and Custom Models private betas, Prompt to Edit GA, 'Project Moonlight' assistant. Apr 2026 (NAB): Firefly Boards for film pre-visualisation, partner video models Kling 3.0, Topaz Astra, FLUX.2, Premiere Color Mode. 2026: Firefly Foundry enterprise models with NVIDIA; new Firefly for teams plans (helpx, May 2026).
tools.best_fit_departments: 31 Marketing & Brand is the only listed department and the fit is strong for imagery, video and campaign variants; it is not a copywriting tool, so 'brand-safe copy' should pair Firefly with Express/Copilot/Claude. Would also suit 13 L&D and 32 Digital Marketing although not listed.
tools.training_notes: Learn prompt and reference-image technique, Generative Fill/Expand editing, Content Credentials and disclosure norms, credit budgeting (video burns credits fastest), which outputs are indemnified (Firefly vs partner vs beta), and brand Custom Models. Core 6-8 hours for marketers; Advanced 12-20 hours for Boards, Custom Models and Services API automation.
tools.caveats: Generative credits are the real cost lever and video/premium features consume many more; partner models change the commercial-safety and indemnity position; beta features carry usage restrictions; copyright in outputs depends on jurisdiction; HIPAA not listed; MAX 2026 (Nov) may again reshape plans.

tools.name: Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant
tools.vendor: Adobe Inc., Document Cloud (brief's guess correct). PACKAGING CHANGE: AI Assistant is now sold mainly inside 'Acrobat Studio' (Aug 2025) and 'Acrobat Studio for enterprise'; the standalone add-on persists for some plans, and Sept 2026 materials reference 'Acrobat Express' and 'AI Assistant Plus' tiers.
tools.what_it_is: A generative assistant inside Acrobat and Acrobat Reader (Windows/macOS desktop, web, Chrome/Edge extension, iOS/Android, Adobe Scan, Microsoft Teams integration) that summarises documents, answers questions with clickable citations, compares contracts and builds 'PDF Spaces' knowledge hubs over up to 100 files. Since 2026 it also generates presentations and podcast-style audio from documents.
key_capabilities: Generative summaries/outlines and cited Q&A across PDFs, Office files, meeting transcripts (Teams/Zoom) and web links
PDF Spaces: shareable knowledge hubs with role-based AI assistants (Analyst, Instructor, custom) and view/comment/add permissions
Contract intelligence: auto-recognises contracts (incl. scans), extracts key terms, compares up to 10 agreements
Generate presentation (brand kits, export PPT/PDF) and Generate podcast from documents; edit PDFs by chat
Enterprise Knowledge Base deployed into Slack, Teams, PDF Spaces and web, synced from SharePoint and Google Drive
Analyzer: plain-language criteria extraction across thousands of contracts/invoices with outputs to ERP/CRM/CLM
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Adobe states it does not use customer documents to train AI models and contractually prohibits its LLM providers from doing so (all tiers). Architecture: Adobe Generative AI Service on AWS (North America, EMEA, APAC) calls Microsoft Azure OpenAI with abuse monitoring disabled; document content, prompts and responses are cached 12 hours then deleted; chat history is stored on-device (desktop/mobile) or in Adobe cloud (web); optional enterprise consent to retain sessions 30 days for product improvement. TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest. Enterprise admins assign AI Assistant via Admin Console product profiles and can disable it or cloud chat history per profile; Federated ID (SAML SSO) or Enterprise ID required. Not available on 0GB or China SKUs. Adobe's compliance list shows SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001:2022, FedRAMP Tailored and HIPAA-ready for Document Cloud (Acrobat Sign); confirm scope for AI Assistant specifically.
tools.licensing_pricing: Individuals (USD, annual billed monthly): Acrobat Standard US$14.99 and Pro US$19.99 have no AI; Acrobat Studio US$24.99/mo includes AI Assistant, PDF Spaces and Adobe Express Premium. Teams: Standard US$16.99, Pro US$23.99, Studio US$29.99 per license/month. Enterprise: via Adobe resellers/ETLA, contact sales. The AI Assistant add-on was US$4.99/mo for Reader/Acrobat individuals (Feb 2025); free users get limited AI requests. Not part of Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
tools.integrations: Microsoft Teams, Chrome/Edge extension, SharePoint and Google Drive connectors, Slack (Knowledge Base), Teams/Zoom transcripts, Adobe Express brand kits, Acrobat Sign e-signature, ERP/CRM/CLM outputs from Analyzer.
tools.recent_developments: 4 Feb 2025: contract intelligence (summaries, compare up to 10 contracts). 19 Aug 2025: Acrobat Studio launched with PDF Spaces (up to 100 docs) at US$24.99 individuals/US$29.99 teams. Jan 2026: enterprise Knowledge Base and Analyzer. 9 Sept 2026: 'Adobe Productivity Agent' adds interactive reports, Stylize, podcasts and auto presentations across Acrobat Studio, Acrobat Express and AI Assistant Plus. Helpx (Aug 2026) adds editing PDFs via AI chat.
tools.best_fit_departments: 04 Board Secretariat & Corporate Governance is a strong fit: board packs and minutes in PDF Spaces with cited Q&A, action extraction and controlled sharing. Also well suited (unlisted) to legal, procurement and compliance teams per Adobe's own positioning.
tools.training_notes: Learn to verify citations, curate PDF Spaces and permissions, use contract compare, write precise questions, understand retention (12-hour cache, web chat in cloud) and what must not be uploaded. Core 6-8 hours for governance staff.
tools.caveats: AI appears only in the Studio tier on current price lists, so legacy Pro users need an upgrade or add-on; English-first (contract features English-only at launch, limited languages); depends on Azure OpenAI; outputs need human review for legal content (Computerworld analysts); attestations are product-specific; packaging names change often.

tools.name: Figma AI
tools.vendor: Figma, Inc. (brief's guess correct). 'Figma AI' is the umbrella for AI across Figma Design, Figma Make, Figma Agent, Figma Weave, Sites, Buzz, Draw, Motion, Dev Mode and FigJam.
tools.what_it_is: AI features built into Figma's browser/desktop design platform: the Figma Agent generates and remixes designs and automates tasks on the canvas, Figma Make turns prompts and designs into working prototypes and web apps, Weave tools run image/video/audio generation workflows, and Dev Mode exposes designs to coding agents through an MCP server. Access is by seat type on Figma plans, metered by monthly AI credits.
key_capabilities: Figma Agent (GA June 2026): generate and remix designs, give feedback, build custom skills, call external tools via MCP, search the web; chats visible to collaborators
Figma Make: prompt-to-code prototypes and apps with design-system context, Payload CMS backend, point-and-edit refinement
Weave tools for image/video/audio generation and edits (background swaps, logo placement); shader fills; Motion animations
Productivity: visual search, rename layers, text rewrite/tone, image edits, add interactions
Dev Mode MCP server and Code Layers (open beta Oct 2026) so AI agents read and act on designs; Specs markdown design-rules editor
Optional AI copyright protection on Organization and Enterprise at no extra cost
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Content training is off by default on Organization and Enterprise plans and cannot be enabled; on by default for Starter and Professional, where admins can toggle it off. Admins can disable AI features at organization or workspace level. Figma uses third-party models (e.g. OpenAI) which store data temporarily or not at all and are not permitted to train on Figma customer content; Education and Government content is never used. Certifications: SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, ISO 27001:2022 with 27017/27018/27701, ISO 42001 (AI management), FedRAMP Authorized (Figma for Government), C5, TISAX, EU Cloud Code of Conduct. Enterprise adds SCIM seat management, EU localized file hosting and the Governance+ add-on (IP allowlisting, enforced 2FA, session controls).
tools.licensing_pricing: USD per seat per month, annual billing: Professional Full US$16 (3,000 AI credits/mo), Dev US$12, Collab US$3; Organization Full US$55 (3,500), Dev US$25, Collab US$5 (annual only); Enterprise Full US$90 (4,250), Dev US$35, Collab US$5 (annual only). Starter free with 150 credits/day (500/month). Dev/Collab/View seats get 500 credits. Make and all AI features are included in seats, no separate SKU; credits reset monthly, no rollover; admins can buy more or cap users. Typical costs: Make 30-100+ credits per prompt, Agent 30-300+, Code Layers 175-315+. Not bundled with any office suite.
tools.integrations: Dev Mode MCP server and 20+ MCP tool partners, GitHub organizations, Payload CMS, Jira/Asana (via FigJam), Figma Sites publishing, local codebase sync (announced).
tools.recent_developments: 24 Jun 2026 (Config): Figma Agent launched to all paid plans; Motion, shader effects, generative plugins and Weave tools in Design; agent for FigJam/Slides on waitlist. 14 Oct 2026 (Config India): Specs editor, Code Layers open beta, agent skills/MCP/web search, 20+ MCP partners, Payload CMS integration for Make. ISO 42001 certification added to security page. Credit-based AI metering is now standard across all seats.
tools.best_fit_departments: 40 Product Design & UX Research: strong for wireframe ideation, prompt-to-prototype testing and UX copy; research synthesis itself is better done in FigJam. Unlisted but relevant: 39 Product Management (Make prototypes for PRDs) and 41 Engineering (Dev Mode MCP).
tools.training_notes: Master design-system-grounded prompting, Make prototype iteration and code review, credit budgeting and admin caps, MCP/agent governance, and plan-level training settings. Advanced 12-20 hours for designers; Specialist 20-30 for teams wiring Dev Mode MCP into engineering workflows.
tools.caveats: Credit consumption is variable and can exhaust a seat mid-month; Organization/Enterprise are annual-only; many features remain beta; Professional plan trains on content unless turned off; agent-generated code needs security review; prices rose in 2025 and seat types changed, so budget carefully.

tools.name: FigJam AI
tools.vendor: Figma, Inc. (brief's guess correct). FigJam is Figma's online whiteboard; its AI features share Figma's AI credit pool and admin settings.
tools.what_it_is: AI built into FigJam, Figma's collaborative whiteboard (web and iPad). It generates boards, diagrams, flowcharts, timelines and project plans from text prompts, sorts and summarises sticky notes, offers the ChatGPT-based Jambot widget and text/image tools. FigJam is included with every seat on every Figma plan; the Figma Agent is being extended into FigJam.
key_capabilities: Generate meeting boards, team exercises, flowcharts, Gantt charts and project plans from a prompt
Sort stickies by theme, author, colour or stamps and summarise selections into takeaways and next steps (free, no credits)
Jambot widget for brainstorming, mind maps, reframing text and Q&A
Text rewrite, translate, shorten and tone adjustment; image generation, background removal, upscaling and object erasure
Diagrams embeddable in Figma Specs design-rule documents; integrations with Jira, Asana and GitHub
24-hour free guest access for external workshop participants
tools.enterprise_data_handling: Same Figma controls: content training off and locked on Organization and Enterprise; on by default for Starter/Professional with admin opt-out; admins can disable AI features entirely. Third-party model vendors (e.g. OpenAI for Jambot) store data temporarily or not at all and may not train on Figma customer content. Certifications as for Figma: SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, ISO 27001/27701, ISO 42001, FedRAMP Authorized (Government), C5, TISAX. AI tools require a paid plan and a Full, Dev or Collab seat.
tools.licensing_pricing: No separate price: FigJam ships with every seat. Cheapest access is a Collab seat at US$3/mo (Professional) or US$5/mo (Organization/Enterprise, annual) with 500 AI credits per month; Full seats carry 3,000-4,250 credits. Summarise/cluster stickies are free actions; board/diagram generation and image tools consume credits that reset monthly without rollover. Not bundled with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
tools.integrations: Jira, Asana, GitHub, Figma Design and Slides handoff, Figma Specs embeds, iPad app.
tools.recent_developments: Nov 2023 launch of FigJam AI (generate, sort, summarise). Jun 2026 (Config): Figma Agent announced for FigJam and Slides (waitlist). Oct 2026 (Config India): FigJam diagrams embeddable in the new Specs editor. Mar 2026 independent review (MakerStack 7.4/10): AI clustering useful but occasionally produces odd groupings; no offline mode.
tools.best_fit_departments: 40 Product Design & UX Research: strong fit for research synthesis (clustering interview notes), journey mapping workshops and usability theme summaries. Could also serve 54 PMO and 56 Process Excellence for retros and process maps, though not listed.
tools.training_notes: Learn facilitation with generated boards, reviewing AI sticky clusters and summaries for lost nuance, template/diagram prompting, guest access and sharing controls, and credit awareness. Core 6 hours is sufficient even for the Advanced-tier department; add 4 hours for Jambot and agent features.
tools.caveats: AI needs a paid plan; outputs carry Figma's 'may be misleading or wrong' disclaimer; advanced diagramming lags Miro/Lucid; Jambot relies on OpenAI; credits shared with Figma Design can be exhausted by Make/Agent use elsewhere; agent features still rolling out.
